title: Riesz transform characterization of Hardy spaces associated with Dunkl--Schrödinger operators
summary: Let $L=-Δ_k+V$ be a Schrödinger operator associated with the Dunkl Laplacian and a nonnegative potential. We characterize the Hardy space $H_L^1$, defined by the maximal operator of the semigroup generated by $-L$, in terms of the Riesz transforms associated with $L$.
